prompts.people_start: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one wide 16:9 photographic editorial scene for a high-school educational video, matching the mature natural photographic realism of the supplied course board, not its typography or layout. Reference image role: character continuity only. The same red-haired freckled teenage girl Maya with loosely tied-back hair and green number 96 hockey jersey, and the same dark-haired boy with black glasses and green number 4 jersey, now at a classroom library table with two other high-school classmates in ordinary muted casual clothes. Medium-wide eye-level framing, all four people and the shared table clearly visible. Maya is on the right; glasses boy left; another girl in a muted blue shirt toward the center; another boy in gray at far left. They have just completed a history project. Most students show relaxed satisfaction, small natural smiles, looking at their completed pages, not cheering. Maya looks attentively at the paper in front of her. Shared printed project pages with small archival-photo blocks and faint unreadable lines, notebook and one open laptop on table. No visible factual claims, no legible document titles. Warm natural window light, grounded school library background, realistic hands, believable proportions. Preserve Maya and glasses boy likeness and green jerseys from reference. No speech bubble, captions, border, takeaway banner, watermark, added text or giant symbols. Reserve lower 15% of frame as tabletop where short spoken words can later be typeset. Single coherent scene.
prompts.basketball_start: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one wide 16:9 candid photographic editorial scene for a high-school learning video. Ordinary school gym with realistic hardwood court and one basketball hoop visible in distant background. Medium-wide sideline view of a school basketball captain, a 17-year-old boy with short curly dark hair wearing a plain navy basketball uniform, holding a basketball securely in both hands on the LEFT foreground. A teammate in matching navy uniform stands on the RIGHT midground with hands ready to receive a pass. Another navy teammate stands further back near the center. One opponent in plain light gray uniform stands near the center BACKGROUND, several steps behind the clear passing lane between foreground captain and right teammate. Natural gym lighting, mature realistic anatomy and hands, believable court scale, all relevant players visible head to foot with floor under feet. The teaching point is a familiar clear passing lane before a defender closes it. No passing arrows, text, logos, jersey numbers, scoreboard, trophy, guaranteed-success imagery, crowd montage, comic effects or watermark. Keep positions and camera especially clear because later versions will move the gray defender into the lane and change the captain's choice.
prompts.donation: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one wide 16:9 photographic editorial scene for a high-school learning video, natural soft daylight, mature grounded composition in an ordinary school multipurpose room. A student-led donation drive in action. Three high-school-age students in ordinary muted casual clothing at a sorting table. Student coordinator on LEFT in an olive overshirt checks a short paper checklist with a pencil while looking toward the delivery. In CENTER another student in blue hands a neatly packed cardboard box of school supplies toward a third student on RIGHT who receives it securely with both hands, ready to carry it out. The box handoff is the clear focal point. A few plain notebooks and pencils are being sorted on the table. The checklist has only small indistinct marks, no readable personal names or quantities. Show concrete responsibility and completed work for others, not a posed group or an adult giving orders. Realistic faces, proportions, fingers, box weight and grip; neutral positive expressions, coherent room and perspective. No charity branding, donation totals, signs, slogans, speech bubbles, logos, watermark, robots, or stylized drawing. Single clean scene, not collage.
prompts.people_suggest: Edit target: supplied history-project group photograph. Preserve exact same four students, faces, clothing, seating positions, table papers, laptop, library, lighting, camera and wide 16:9 composition. Change only their expressions, gaze and gesture to the next moment: Maya, red-haired girl in green number 96 on right, has noticed an issue and is explaining a suggestion. Her mouth is slightly open mid-sentence, one hand points clearly at the project sheet and her gaze is toward her classmates. The boy in glasses listens toward her. Other two students remain relaxed at the same positions. Natural ordinary interaction, no exaggerated acting. No captions or speech bubbles, no new people or objects. Keep the papers free of readable text.
prompts.people_quiet: Edit target: supplied history-project group photograph. Preserve exact same four students, identity, jerseys and clothing, seating positions, table pages, laptop, library, lighting, camera and wide 16:9 composition. Change only expressions, gaze and hands to a later moment after Maya was interrupted: Maya, red-haired girl in green number 96 on right, now sits slightly back, both hands withdrawn from the project and resting together near her own edge of table, mouth closed, gaze down at her own hands. Understated neutral quiet expression, not crying, no exaggerated sadness or anger. The other three students now look toward one another or the laptop and carry on their discussion, with the gray hoodie boy making a small conversational gesture. The viewer must see Maya has stopped participating while the group continues. No speech bubbles, no captions, no added objects, no change to framing.
prompts.people_interrupt: Edit target: supplied group photograph where Maya is suggesting a change. Preserve exact same four students, faces, clothing, table, project pages, laptop, library, lighting, camera and wide composition. Change the far-left gray-hoodie boy: he turns his head toward Maya on the right, mouth slightly open while cutting in, raises one hand in a small calm stop gesture at chest level. This should be a plausible casual interruption, not angry confrontation. Maya is still pointing at the paper but stops talking and looks toward him. Glasses boy and girl in blue remain in their seats and glance toward the gray-hoodie speaker. No shouting, aggression or exaggerated reactions. No speech bubbles or captions; we will add the exact narration text separately. All objects and other details stay unchanged.
prompts.basketball_pass: Edit target: supplied basketball photograph with the gray-uniform defender now blocking the direct route to the navy teammate on right. Preserve exact same four players and faces, clothing, gym, floor, basket, lighting, camera and wide 16:9 composition. Show the captain actually switching to the other play: captain on left turns his shoulders and gaze toward his OPEN navy teammate in the BACK CENTER-LEFT by the doorway, and makes a two-handed chest pass to that teammate. Only one basketball, now airborne just in front of the open center-left teammate's ready hands, clearly on the short diagonal lane from captain to that teammate, well to the LEFT of the gray defender. Captain's hands extended after releasing the ball, no ball left in his hands. Open teammate now lifts both hands to receive. Gray defender stays in exactly the same center-right stance blocking the original pass toward the right teammate, who stays in position. Do not move players, add people, change camera, add basket outcome, score, text, arrows or logos. Natural realistic throwing and receiving anatomy. This is a changed passing choice, not a winning shot.
